title: Explorable model with a clamped orbit and hotspot buttons
summary: Model in a native `<dialog>` on a spherical goal / current camera damped by `1 − k^dt` (drag `.0004`, fly `.02`), polar clamped to `0.85–1.3` rad and distance to `7–15`, zones as real `aria-pressed` buttons pinned to projected targets that fly the camera there, arrow / `+` / `−` / Home keys on the focused stage; instant fly-tos under reduced motion, poster plus the same list in the static tier
variants: Three.js procedural model in a native dialog, hand-written spherical orbit with 1 − k^dt damping (this, default)
Draco / KTX2 glb through GLTFLoader, hotspot targets read from named empties in the file
camera-controls (smoothTime, min/maxPolarAngle, setLookAt) when a project already ships it
R3F: the same goal/current pair in useFrame, hotspots as drei <Html> wrapping real buttons
